headline: Financial Times: Ferrexpo has one problem: Zhevago
summary: A Financial Times report cited by Dzerkalo Tyzhnia says reducing Vadim Zhevago's stake below 25% could remove a main obstacle to Ferrexpo recovering VAT refunds. Ferrexpo is an iron ore pellet producer with Ukrainian operations.
why: Ferrexpo is an iron ore pellet producer whose main operations are in Ukraine, so cash recovery from tax refunds directly affects its finances.
